written_before_data: Written before scripts/research/multivenue_recorder.py recorded any data. Only the OWN-PRECHECK spread snapshot and the 2026-10-05 07:0x metaAndAssetCtxs/orderBooks metadata (fees, growth mode, market ids; no prices analysed) have been seen.
statement: On tokenized-equity and metal perps listed on Binance USD-M, Hyperliquid HIP-3 trade[XYZ] and Lighter, when the leading venue's mid moves >= theta bp within 2 s and a follower's mid has moved < theta/2, a follower taker order in the leader's direction, held H seconds, is profitable after fees and the recorded spread.
source: sources/leads/documented_edges_round7.md idea 2 (grid theta x H x follower kept as written there; the latency dimension is carried by the follower: xyz 300 ms, Lighter 300 + 300 ms speed bump).

data.streams: binance bbo (bookTicker), hyperliquid bbo + trades (coin xyz:<NAME>), lighter bbo (ticker channel) + trades; hourly xyz metaAndAssetCtxs and Lighter orderBooks metadata snapshots (meta_*.jsonl)
data.clock_rule: Local receive timestamps (microseconds). A venue state 'at time t' is the last recorded row with ts_us <= t.

split.T0: launch time of the 48-h recorder run (recorder.log 'start' line; also in reports/hypotheses/multivenue_plan.md). Rows before T0 are never scored.
split.day1_train: [T0, T0+24h): leader map (pre-check 0) + all 12 configs; ONE config selected
split.day2_validation: [T0+24h, T0+48h): the selected config only, run ONCE, with the day-1 leader map unchanged
split.forward: freeze after day 2; score only data received after the freeze time

data.sessions: cash_open = Mon-Fri 13:30-20:00 UTC (NYSE regular hours, EDT); cash_closed = all other times. Used for the leader map and reported separately; the grid is not split by session.
data.gaps: No trigger while any of the three venues has no bbo row for that name for > 30 s; positions crossing a gap close at the first state after it and are flagged.

precheck0_leader_map_day1.method: For each name x session on day 1: sample each venue's mid on a 100 ms grid (last state), log returns; cross-correlation for each venue pair at lags -2 s..+2 s in 100 ms steps. Venue A leads B if sum of corr at lags where A precedes B exceeds the sum where B precedes A. The leader is the venue that leads both others.
precheck0_leader_map_day1.fallback: If no venue leads both others, or a name x session has < 1,000 non-zero 100 ms leader returns, the leader is Binance.
precheck0_leader_map_day1.followers: the venues among {xyz, lighter} that are not the leader
precheck0_leader_map_day1.frozen: the map is written to reports/hypotheses/eqlag_leader_map.json before any P&L is computed and is not changed afterwards

rule.trigger: At each leader bbo row (t = its ts_us): r = mid_lead(t)/mid_lead(t-2s) - 1; trigger if |r| >= theta, d = sign(r); require the follower's d * (mid_f(t)/mid_f(t-2s) - 1) < theta/2.
rule.entry: Follower taker in direction d. Fill time t_in = t + L (xyz: 300 ms; Lighter: 600 ms = ~300 ms ours + 300 ms Standard-account taker speed bump). Buy at the last recorded follower best ask at t_in, sell at best bid.
rule.exit: Exit decision at t_in + H; fill at t_out = t_in + H + L at the last recorded opposite best.
rule.position_rules: one position per name per follower; cooldown 10 s after exit fill
rule.size: target $1,000; entry size = min($1,000, displayed opposite top-of-book notional at t_in); skip (counted) if < $100. Exit size beyond the displayed opposite top at t_out fills one full spread worse.

fees_per_side.xyz_growth_mode: 0.9 bp taker (tier 0, base rate, DOC) for names whose meta snapshot shows growthMode 'enabled'
fees_per_side.xyz_standard: 9.0 bp taker (tier 0 standard HIP-3 = 2x validator fees, DOC) for names without growthMode enabled. At 2026-10-05 07:0x UTC this was xyz:GOLD and xyz:MSTR (the trade.xyz doc says gold and crypto-wrapper perps such as MSTR are not eligible for growth mode).
fees_per_side.rule: the fee for each trade uses the latest hourly meta snapshot at or before the entry time (growthMode and deployerFeeScale; the fee is multiplied by deployerFeeScale/1.0)

rule.pnl_unit: USD per round trip; bp = USD / notional * 1e4

selection_rule_day1: Among configs with n >= 30 round trips on day 1 (pooled over names), select the highest profit factor (ties: larger n). If none has net USD > 0 and PF > 1.0, H-EQLAG is KILLED and day 2 is not run. The selected config must also be net > 0 with +0.5 bp extra cost per round trip, else take the next-best that is.
validation_day2: Selected config once on day 2. Bar: n >= 50, net USD > 0, PF > 1.2, net without top-3 trades > 0. n < 50 = INCONCLUSIVE; freeze anyway and continue forward until n >= 50, no re-selection.
reporting: All 12 day-1 configs by name and session (n, net, mean bp, PF, skips), the leader map, the day-2 result; losses included.
no_changes: No change to names, grid, fill model, fees rule, split, leader-map method or selection rule after this file is written.
